$comment: GET v25/customers:listAccessibleCustomers, read from Google's v25 discovery document. It requires no customer id and explicitly ignores login-customer-id, making it useful before the caller has selected an account.
title: Accessible Google Ads customers
description: List Google Ads customer resource names directly accessible to the authenticated user. Manager-linked client accounts are not included; query the account hierarchy after choosing a directly accessible manager.

request.$pathComment: The colon names a REST-transcoded service method; it is literal path syntax, not a customer-id placeholder. Google documents REST and gRPC as supported call surfaces, with gRPC preferred by its client libraries.

outputShape.description: Customer resource names in customers/{customer_id} form that the OAuth identity can access directly.

$outputComment: The discovery response is the created top-level response object itself: one resourceNames array, with no data wrapper from Google. `data` here is the connector output path vocabulary, not a claimed wire envelope.
